RAOD Securitization Facility On November 16, 2026, Receivable Assets of OnDeck, LLC (“ RAOD ”), a wholly-owned indirect subsidiary of Enova International, Inc. (the “ Company ”), amended RAOD’s existing asset-backed revolving debt facility (the “ RAOD Securitization Facility ”) by entering into Amendment No. 13 to Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement (the “ Thirteenth Amendment ”) with the lenders party thereto from time to time, and Truist Bank, as administrative agent. The following table summarizes certain key terms of the amended RAOD Securitization Facility: Class A Revolving Loans Class B Revolving Loans Total Facility Commitment Amount $300,000,000 $65,131,578.95 $365,131,578.95 Borrowing Rate SOFR + 1.30% SOFR + 6.00% SOFR + 2.14% Borrowing Base Advance Rate 76% 92.5% 92.5% Revolving Period End Date November 2028 November 2028 November 2028 Maturity Date November 2029 November 2029 November 2029 The foregoing description of the Thirteenth Amendment does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, as previously amended and as amended by the Thirteenth Amendment, which will be filed as an exhibit to the Company’s Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ending December 31, 2026.
